units.source_text: 源氏又闭居在离开正屋的那间别室中，专心写字。

en.t: Genji again shut himself away in the separate room apart from the main building and devoted himself to writing.

units.source_text: 其时春花已过盛期，天空澄碧，日丽风和。

en.t: By then the spring blossoms had passed their peak, the sky was clear blue, the sun was bright, and the wind was gentle.

units.source_text: 各种古歌浮现脑际，他就随心所欲地用假名写出，或用草体，或用普通体，无不异常秀美。

en.t: All sorts of old poems came to mind, and he wrote them out in kana as he pleased, sometimes in cursive script and sometimes in a regular hand, each one extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 身边侍女不多，只留二三人司理磨墨等事。

en.t: There were not many gentlewomen attending him; only two or three remained to take care of such tasks as grinding ink.

units.source_text: 这二三人都有学识，从优良的古歌集中选取诗歌时，何者宜于入选，可同她们商量。

en.t: These two or three women were all cultivated, so when he chose poems from fine old anthologies, he could consult them about which ones should be included.

units.source_text: 帘幕尽行卷起，源氏落拓不羁地坐在窗前，将册子置于矮几之上，口中衔着笔尖，凝神思索，其姿态之优美，令人百看不厌。

en.t: With all the blinds rolled up, Genji sat at ease by the window, set the booklet on a low table, held the tip of his brush in his mouth, and pondered intently; the beauty of his posture was something one could never tire of seeing.

units.source_text: 册子中每逢白色或红色等触目的一页，他就改变执笔姿势，用心书写。

en.t: Whenever he came to a striking page in the booklet, such as one of white or red paper, he changed the way he held the brush and wrote with special care.

units.source_text: 这姿态也很优美，知情识趣的人见了，无不为之神往。

en.t: That posture too was very graceful, and anyone with taste and feeling who saw it could not help being enchanted.
